title: Sleepy llama
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='26' ry='17' fill='#f2d9a8'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='33' y='78' width='8' height='14' rx='4' fill='#e0bd80'/>
  <rect x='45' y='79' width='8' height='13' rx='4' fill='#e0bd80'/>
  <rect x='57' y='78' width='8' height='14' rx='4' fill='#e0bd80'/>
  <rect x='67' y='79' width='7' height='13' rx='3.5' fill='#e0bd80'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='58' y='40' width='13' height='28' rx='6' fill='#f2d9a8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='38' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#f2d9a8'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='43' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#e8c48f'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='41' rx='2.2' ry='1.6' fill='#c9986a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M55 29 Q52 18 60 25 Z' fill='#e8c48f'/>
  <path d='M70 27 Q73 16 78 25 Z' fill='#e8c48f'/>
  <!-- closed sleepy eyes -->
  <path d='M60 36 Q63 39 66 36' stroke='#7a5230' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M71 35 Q74 38 77 35' stroke='#7a5230' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little blush -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='42' r='2.2' fill='#f0a0a0'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='41' r='2.2' fill='#f0a0a0'/>
  <!-- woolly top and tail -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='55' r='7' fill='#fff1d6'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='50' r='7' fill='#fff1d6'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='63' r='6' fill='#fff1d6'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='62' r='5' fill='#fff1d6'/>
  <!-- zzz -->
  <path d='M30 30 h6 l-6 6 h6' stroke='#8fd4ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M40 20 h5 l-5 5 h5' stroke='#8fd4ff' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
</svg>
